w: At 10:30 am, Swamishri arrived in Vanthali and performed the murti-pratishtha at the newly built Swaminarayan mandir.
In the afternoon, Swamishri went to the old mandir, in Vanthali, formerly the home of Kalyanbhai.
From 5.00 p.m. Swamishri performed the Chopada Pujan rituals and then blessed the assembly. ( See News report )
In the evening satsang assembly, the sadhus presented a programme of devotional songs. Also, the Kenyan Finance Minister, David Mwiraria, came to meet Swamishri.

Guest: Pujya Nikhilanand Swami, Chinmaya Mission, explained, “On seeing the Akshardham complex, the first question that arose in mind was, ‘Whose dream was it?’ Then I came to know it was the dream of Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Then there was no doubt that the dream would become a reality. “Just as the Bhagvad Gita is a good book among all books and it is the center of a very appealing philosophy, similarly, if one sees in the whole of Delhi one will find Akshardham to be the most appealing spiritual center.”

After the evening satsang assembly Swamishri was returning to his residence. An aspirant asked Swamishri, “Till 2007 give me a niyam.” Swamishri replied, “ The greatest of all niyams is ‘Nijatamanam brahmarupam’. In it are included all the niyams are included. In times of joy and insult one should remain happy. That is our aim and our niyam. One should always introspect. It is one’s worldly life or in one’s own work no one disturbs or spoils them. It is we who spoil ourselves.”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
13 October 2005, New Delhi
Bhayabhai is 67 years old and is a pujari of Vadu BAPS mandir. He pilgrimaged by foot from Vadu in Gujarat to Akshardham, New Delhi.
14 October 2005, New Delhi

• Vasantbhai Prajapati of Rayam (near Sankari) accomplished his pilgrimage by cycling from Rayam to New Delhi from 1 October to 11 October. Jaydeepsinh pilgrimaged 1100 km by foot from Varad, near Sankari, in 27 days.
15 October 2005, New Delhi
Two BAPS sadhus and 21 youths of Selvas Satsang Mandal accomplished an 8-day (24 – 30 Oct.) pilgrimage by foot carrying a lighted torch from Chhapaiya to Akshardham, New Delhi.
Twenty-six BAPS youths from Vadodara pilgrimaged from Chansad to New Delhi, running a distance of 1,175 km in 25 days.
Twenty-five BAPS youths pilgrimaged by running from Bochasan to Akshardham, New Delhi, from 10-20 October.
16 October 2005, New Delhi
Bhayabhai Makwana pilgrimaged by cycle from Amdavad to Delhi, travelling 1100 km from 26 September to 16 October.
Fifteen BAPS youths cycled from Bodal (Kheda district).
Yogesh B. Patel and Anil N. Gajjar cycled from Amdavad to Delhi in 76 hours from 31 October to 3 November.
24 October 2005, New Delhi
Pujabhai of Bharoda village cycled to Akshardham, New Delhi.

The 222nd birthday celebration of Aksharbrahman Gunatitanand Swami was celebrated in Swamishri’s presence. The mammoth assembly commenced at 7.00 pm. The stage decoration was themed on the BAPS Centenary celebrations. The centenary logo, giant cut-outs of Atlanta and Toronto BAPS mandirs along with a replica of a globe and Akshar Deri formed a giant, spectacular stage backdrop. The celebration programme consisted of speeches, dances and bhajans. The programme was as follows:

Atmatrupt Swami spoke on Swamishri’s satsang vicharan abroad. Balaks and kishores performed a traditional dance. Siddheshwar Swami spoke on Gunatitanand Swami. Second arti was performed by devotees. Narayanmuni Swami announced the BAPS Centenary Celebration programme and invitation to all. Dr Swami spoke on how to celebrate the centenary. Third arti was performed. Balaks and Kishores presented highlights of ‘Century of BAPS’ on stage. Mahant Swami addressed the assembly. Senior sadhus honoured Swamishri with garlands. Kishores performed a traditional dance. Finally Swamishri blessed the celebration assembly, “The festival of Sharad Punam has been celebrated here ever since the mandir was built. Yogiji Maharaj always celebrated this festival here in Gondal every year.
